title: Why the Wild Hunt hunted Ciri in The Witcher 3
subject: ciri
description:
Would you have run from the Wild Hunt, or fought it? 👇

Why Ciri's Elder Blood made her the most hunted person in The Witcher 3. Spoilers for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt.

scenes.text: Ciri was born carrying blood an entire elven army wanted.
She was a princess of Cintra, heir to the Elder Blood of the elf Lara Dorren.
That blood let her step between worlds and slip through time.
King Eredin's Wild Hunt wanted it to escape the White Frost devouring their world.
So Ciri kept running, while Geralt searched three lands for her: Velen, Novigrad and Skellige.
The elves called her Zireael. In Elder Speech, it means swallow.
And like a swallow, Ciri could never stop flying.
